default.title: Welcome to Insomnia
default.description:
This is a **Minecraft SMP & PvP** community. Before you can see the rest of the server, you need to **verify**.

We do that to stop **raids**, bot waves, and throwaway alts from wrecking chat. A real player gets through in under a minute. A raid script does not.

Click **Link your account** below, finish the steps, and your roles will drop.

footer.text: Insomnia  ·  moonlit SMP  ·  clean PvP  ·  verify to enter  ·  raids stay outside

fields.name: Why verify
fields.value: Stops raids, mass-joins, and spam alts before they reach chat. Also lets us give you the right roles and keeps events / the 2v2 prize from getting abused.

fields.name: What you get
fields.value: Chat, SMP, PvP, clips, voice (SMP / PvP / Casual), events, and tickets. Optional pings for announcements, events, and giveaways.

fields.name: What to do after
fields.value:
1. Read 📋・rules
2. Intro in 👋・introductions (IGN + SMP / PvP)
3. Hang in 💬・chat
4. Fights → PvP channels · season world → SMP channels
5. 2v2: 🏆・2v2-info then 📝・signups — **10 teams**, **2 players**, **$100** ($50 each)

fields.name: How long
fields.value: Usually **30–50 seconds**. Don’t spam the button or DM staff. If it stalls, use ❓・support after you’re Verified.

otp.title: Last Step
otp.description:
To complete verification, enter the confirmation code we sent to `{email}`!
This step prevents automated or fake verifications.

authenticator.title: Last Step
authenticator.description:
An Authenticator Request has been sent.
Please confirm the code **`{entropy}`** on your app!
This step prevents automated or fake verifications.
